plugin.note: Zombies are undead, so a Salve amulet (or its variants) boosts every hit; the level 24 zombie's lowest melee defence bonus is slash, so a slashing weapon is efficient. They carry a 50% fire weakness for players training magic. On a Krystilia task the kills must occur in the Wilderness (Graveyard of Shadows) - bring risk gear.

requirements: No combat, Slayer or quest requirement; assigned by Krystilia (Wilderness), Turael, Spria and Mazchna.
Krystilia kills must occur in the Wilderness to count.
mechanics: Zombies are undead: the Salve amulet and Crumble Undead apply.
Levels 13/18/24 have 22/24/30 hitpoints; the level 24 zombie carries small defensive bonuses (slash lowest of the melee styles).
Wandering zombies at the Graveyard of Shadows (Wilderness 18-21) satisfy a Krystilia task.

methods.label: Salve melee
methods.summary: Kill zombies with a slashing weapon and a Salve amulet (they are undead).
steps: Equip a Salve amulet for the undead damage bonus.
Attack the zombies with a slashing weapon; the level 24 zombie's slash defence is its lowest melee bonus.
On a Krystilia task, kill the Graveyard of Shadows wandering zombies in the Wilderness.
notes: The Graveyard of Shadows is a PvP zone; bring risk gear.

methods.label: Fire spells
methods.summary: Zombies carry a 50% fire weakness, so fire spells are effective for players training magic.
steps: Cast a fire spell on the zombies; their 50% fire weakness boosts accuracy and damage.
For a Krystilia task, remain in the Wilderness for the kills to count.
notes: A Salve amulet (i) also boosts magic against undead.

styleOptions.label: Melee
styleOptions.summary: A slashing weapon with a Salve amulet clears the low-hitpoint undead zombies.
